aboutUs.title: Building the education platform of the future, together.
aboutUs.description1: We started with a simple observation: most language learning centers and platforms are either boring or offer very limited speaking practice. We built our center to completely close this gap.
aboutUs.description2: Our approach combines advanced teaching methodology with a comfortable, student-focused environment, enabling fluent real-time communication instead of tedious memorization.
aboutUs.card1Desc: Specially designed intensive programs ensure noticeable language progress in a short period.
aboutUs.card2Desc: The main focus of lessons is live communication and speaking, helping to overcome the language barrier in a short time.
aboutUs.card3Desc: We work individually on each student's mistakes and weaknesses, leading them to high results.
aboutUs.locationDesc: We are located in Uzbekistan, Bukhara city, near the "Bukhara State Medical College" complex. Our modern and cozy learning center is always open for you. Come and get to know our learning process up close!
aboutUs.footerTitle: Toward the goal, together, with confidence.
aboutUs.footerDesc: Our team of experienced teachers provides students with continuous support, ensuring they achieve high certifications and a fluent level of communication.

sec3.title: Meet Our Specialists
sec3.successToast: Your request has been sent successfully!

asilbek.description: I got IELTS 9.0 three times in a row, and honestly, none of it happened by accident. Every session I run is built around one idea — impossible is a word people use before they've tried hard enough. I break down every skill into something manageable, track your weak points relentlessly, and push you past the plateau most students get stuck at. My students don't just pass the exam, they walk out speaking with real confidence. If you're ready to put in the work, I'll make sure the result follows.

ruxillo.description: Ruxillo started learning English on his own while still in school, and within just a few years became one of the most sought-after teachers in his city. He specializes in IELTS preparation and speaking practice, breaking down complex grammar topics into simple, easy-to-understand explanations. Over 4 years of teaching, he has prepared more than 200 students who scored IELTS 7 or higher, and he continues refining his own teaching methodology.

zarnigor.description: Zarnigor scored 8.5 on the international IELTS exam at just 17 years old, a remarkable achievement for her age. She holds a CELTA certificate and specializes in developing speaking skills and refining pronunciation. Zarnigor believes every student can reach a high result if the material is explained clearly and with patience, and that's exactly the approach she brings to every lesson.

gulasal.description: Gulasal holds the maximum IELTS score of 9.0 and a TESOL certificate, qualifying her to teach English at an international level. Over 5 years of practice, she has prepared more than 600 students, many of whom successfully entered universities abroad. Gulasal focuses on academic writing and confident spoken English, helping students not just pass the exam but truly master the language.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Check out the answers to the most common questions from our students.
faq.q1: How long do our courses last?
faq.a1: Depending on the field, our courses last on average from 3 to 12 months. Classes are held 4 times a week by qualified instructors.
faq.q2: What is required to start the classes?
faq.a2: To get started, you only need a laptop (computer), necessary books, internet connection, and a strong desire to learn. Basic knowledge is taught from scratch.
faq.q3: What happens if I miss a class?
faq.a3: Active participation in every class is recommended. If you cannot attend or struggle with a topic, our experienced assistant teachers will help you outside of class hours, re-explain the covered topics, and assist you with practical exercises.
faq.q4: Is a certificate awarded after completing the course?
faq.a4: Yes, graduates who successfully complete the course receive a special certificate, and top students are provided with practical assistance in finding a job.

ieltsWritingAssessor.analyzingDesc: The AI examiner is reading and evaluating the text...
ieltsWritingAssessor.strCollocationsTemplate: {{count}} B2/C1 academic phrases and collocations found.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impCollocationsTemplate: Use more B2/C1 academic collocations (e.g., 'pivotal role', 'profound impact') in the essay.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impConnectorsTemplate: Use connectors like 'Furthermore', 'Consequently', 'In contrast', 'Therefore' between paragraphs.
ieltsWritingAssessor.strOverview: Contains a clear 'Overview' paragraph required for Task 1.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impOverview: You must include a clear Overview section starting with 'Overall,...' for Task 1.
ieltsWritingAssessor.strParagraphs: The essay is divided into four clear paragraphs (Introduction, 2 Body paragraphs, Conclusion).
ieltsWritingAssessor.impParagraphs: Divide the Task 2 essay into at least 4 distinct paragraphs (Introduction, Body 1, Body 2, Conclusion).
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip1: Paraphrase the topic in the introduction, then discuss the pros and cons of mobile phones in 2 separate paragraphs.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip2: Highlight the most used and least used transport in the Overview. Then compare with data.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip3: Clearly separate the advantages (flexibility, affordability) and disadvantages (lack of live interaction).
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip4: Provide strong arguments about jobs lost to AI and new professional paths created.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip5: Compare the highest performing countries by grouping them against the lower groups.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip6: Elucidate the balance between earning early (advantage) and long-term career limits (disadvantage).
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip7: Describe the sequential process using transition words (Initially, Following this, Subsequently, Finally).
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip8: Conclude that the government's legal authority and citizens' personal responsibility must be synchronized.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip9: Analyze the complex relationship between economic stability, automation, and financial resources using C1/C2 vocabulary.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip10: Compare the decline of fossil fuels with the exponential growth of renewable sources.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip11: Brilliantly argue the inseparable connection between language and culture, and economic resource allocation at a Band 9 level.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip12: Compare the 30-year transformation of the town map by directions (north, south, east, west) and infrastructure.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip13: Highlight the technologies derived from space exploration and attention to Earth's problems using high-level syntax.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip14: Argue the difference between punishment and rehabilitation and its impact on crime reduction.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip15: Write the coffee production stages chronologically and in the passive voice (is roasted, are packaged).

ieltsWriting.p1Prompt: Some people think that mobile phones should be banned in schools, while others believe they are useful educational tools. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
ieltsWriting.p2Title: Task 1: Line Graph - Public Transport Passengers
ieltsWriting.p2Prompt: The line graph below shows the number of passengers using three types of public transport in a European city between 2000 and 2020. Summarize the main features and make comparisons.
ieltsWriting.p3Prompt: Online distance learning is replacing traditional classroom teaching in many universities. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
ieltsWriting.p4Prompt: Some people believe that artificial intelligence will replace human workers in most industries, while others argue it will create new opportunities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
ieltsWriting.p5Prompt: The bar chart compares the percentage of university graduates in six European countries who found employment within six months of graduation between 2010 and 2020. Summarize key trends.
ieltsWriting.p6Title: Task 2: Early Employment vs Higher Education
ieltsWriting.p6Prompt: Many young people prefer going directly into employment after high school rather than pursuing a university degree. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
ieltsWriting.p7Prompt: The diagram illustrates the process of purifying and recycling wastewater for domestic consumption. Describe the stages involved in this system.
ieltsWriting.p8Prompt: Should governments take sole responsibility for solving environmental issues, or should individuals change their lifestyle habits? Discuss both views and give your opinion.
ieltsWriting.p9Prompt: Providing a Universal Basic Income (UBI) to all citizens regardless of employment status is proposed as a solution to wealth inequality. Discuss the feasibility and potential consequences.
ieltsWriting.p10Title: Task 1: Pie Charts - Energy Generation 2005 vs 2035
ieltsWriting.p10Prompt: The pie charts show the proportions of energy generated from different sources in a developed nation in 2005 and projected figures for 2035. Summarize the main features and make comparisons.
ieltsWriting.p11Prompt: Due to globalization, many minority languages are dying out. Some argue that public money should be spent on preserving endangered languages, while others consider it a waste of resources. Discuss both views.
ieltsWriting.p12Prompt: The maps below show the town of Willington in 1995 and proposed redevelopment plans for 2025. Summarize the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
ieltsWriting.p13Prompt: The amount of money spent on space exploration is unjustifiable when there are so many problems on Earth. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ieltsWriting.p14Prompt: The primary purpose of prisons should be to punish criminals rather than to rehabilitate them. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ieltsWriting.p15Prompt: The diagram illustrates the stages of commercial coffee production, from harvesting beans to final packaging. Summarize the information by reporting the main features.
